blocks.x: How Cyber & Zero-Trust lands in Smart Cities & Infrastructure — the constraints that shape the build, the gated delivery pattern, and the deltas we commit against your baseline.

Cities orchestrate mobility, energy, safety and services on shared telemetry — with privacy-by-design as the non-negotiable. The platform pattern (open data contracts, event fabric, measured outcomes) beats vendor lock-in towers every time.

items: ICS/OT in public hands; attacks disrupt life.

blocks.x: The pattern composes AI Security & Model Protection, Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust, Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Urban asset management, Mobility optimization, Public-space governance) on Dataq Sentinel and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — GDPR among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Public Sector & Government level this capability reads as: identity-centric access across agencies and third parties (state-grade threat surface reduced with evidence). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

A fixed rhythm keeps progress visible from week one — here is the one we run. The first quarter of the rhythm is verification: weeks 1–2 measure the current metric with your team and lock it by signature. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with your control owner receiving evidence weekly. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and the measured delta against the signed baseline. Gates are binding: miss one and the program stops or redirects with a documented decision.
